exact_statement: For any disjoint balanced Boolean composition F=g(h_1,...,h_m), g=a+y_j b, q=Inf_j(g), alpha=hat h_j({i}), x=alpha^2: B_i(F)=q B_i(h_j)+L_j(x), D_i(F)=q D_i(h_j)+L_j(x)+J_j(x), where L_j=sum_T(a_T^2+x b_T^2) h_nat(x b_T^2/(a_T^2+x b_T^2)), J_j=E(a^2+x b^2)-(Eraw(a+alpha b)+Eraw(a-alpha b))/2. One has 0<=L_j<=x B_j(g)+qx ln(1/x), 0<=J_j<=2qx, so 0<=R<=x B_j(g)+qx ln(1/x)+2qx. Consequently B(F)<=sum_j q_j B(h_j)+sum_j W_1(h_j)B_j(g)+(2/e)I(F) in nats.

Also sum_v w_v R_v<=sum_v w_v alpha_v^2 B_{j_v}(g_v)+(2+2/e)sum_v w_v Inf_{i_v}(f_v). In bits divide each entropy and its constants by ln(2).
